items.title: Jio Platforms Holds Talks with Comcast and Charter for Strategic Technology-for-Equity Partnerships
items.snippet: Jio Platforms is in advanced discussions with US telecom giants Comcast and Charter Communications to license its UBR technology through technology-for-equity partnerships. The move is part of Jio’s plan to develop its worldwide broadband operations amid rising competition in the US market.

items.title: Upsurge India Acquires Stake in iD Fresh Food in INR 50 Crore Deal; Blue Ashva Exits
items.snippet: Upsurge India has led a secondary deal of INR 50 cr to buy close to 1% interest in iD Fresh Food, which also marks the total exit of early investor Blue Ashva Capital. The offering was co-led by TG Fund and WW Ventures and was oversubscribed by institutional investors.

items.title: OneStack Raises ₹12.5 Cr to Take Co-op Banks Onto UPI
items.snippet: Fintech infrastructure company OneStack has raised ₹12.5 crore from Shepherd's Hill, Pentathlon Ventures and AVNM Ventures. It says partner cooperative banks now run UPI directly with NPCI.

items.title: Peppermint Robotics Raises ₹100 Cr Pre-Series B
items.snippet: Pune-and-Austin robotics company Peppermint has raised ₹100 crore (about $10.5 million) in a pre-Series B led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners, part of it secondary.
